subject.title: fix(gateway): OAuth-only xAI tools are missing from CLI-backend sessions

question: After the type-check repair, should this PR be the canonical fix for the OAuth-only xAI CLI-backend loopback auth-store bug, or should maintainers choose a sibling candidate instead?
rationale: The implementation touches credential-backed provider/tool exposure through the bearer-authenticated loopback path and competes with other open fixes for the same linked issue, so maintainer intent is needed after the mechanical blocker is fixed.

options.title: Repair and land this PR
options.body: Fix the test type error, require exact-head CI plus auth/security-boundary review, then use this branch as the canonical fix and supersede sibling PRs.

options.title: Choose a sibling branch
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer another same-root-cause candidate, but only after confirming the chosen branch preserves both authProfileStore and agentDir through the loopback path.

options.title: Replace with maintainer patch
options.body: Close the competing branches only if maintainers want a narrower owner-authored patch that keeps the same generic auth-store plumbing behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair and land this PR
recommendation.body: Fix the test type error, require exact-head CI plus auth/security-boundary review, then use this branch as the canonical fix and supersede sibling PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway/auth history and previous ClawSweeper routing make this the best available owner for the canonical branch and auth-boundary choice.
